description: A simple chest locker for your servers.

releases.notes:
For use in 26.2 servers and clients (optional)
- Added a client-side overlay that shows a padlock icon on locked containers, so you can tell at a glance which ones are locked (requires the mod on the client)
- The overlay now shows the container's label in front of the lock when you aim at it, only to the owner and trusted players
- Fixed lock entries being lost from /scl list when a single chest was converted into a double chest
- Breaking one half of a double chest now moves the lock to the remaining half instead of losing it
- Server admins can now blacklist blocks in simplechestlocker.json, preventing them from being locked by players
- Updated for Java 25 server providers

For use in 26.2 servers

- Server admins can now blacklist blocks in simplechestlocker.json, preventing them to be locked by players.

For use in 26.2 servers

- Ported to Minecraft 26.2 with official Mojang mappings (Minecraft version is unobfuscated in 26.x, no Yarn needed)
- Updated Fabric Loader to 0.19.3 and Fabric API to 0.156.0+26.2
- Bumped Java toolchain to 26 and Loom to 1.17-SNAPSHOT
- Renamed Player.displayClientMessage to sendSystemMessage; actionbar text now uses ServerPlayer.sendOverlayMessage
- Renamed ClickType to ContainerInput in the GUI menu
- Replaced legacy § formatting codes with component styling using ChatFormatting and withStyle for GUI item names/lore
- MsgHelper now parses § codes and converts them to Component styling at the boundary, so existing command feedback strings stay readable but render through the component API
- Fixed /scl label and /scl rename tab-completion: the optional index/label target is now a separate argument, so tabbing suggests indices/labels instead of replacing the name
- Fixed index ordering: newly locked chests are now appended at the next index instead of being sorted to index 0 by BlockPos; the first chest locked stays at index 0

For use in 1.21.11 servers

- Fixed /scl label and /scl rename tab-completion: the optional index/label target is now a separate argument, so tabbing suggests indices/labels instead of replacing the name
- Fixed index ordering: newly locked chests are now appended at the next index instead of being sorted to index 0 by BlockPos; the first chest locked stays at index 0
- Renamed output jar to include the Minecraft version: simplechestlocker-<mc_version>-<mod_version>.jar

**USE 2.0.5 INSTEAD**

For use in 1.21.11 servers

- Fixed hopper extraction (HopperBlockEntityMixin was inverted, blocking all extraction)
- Fixed composter pushing items into a hopper below
- Reduced PistonBlockMixin to a single injection
- Added /scl version command
- Fixed version mismatch in fabric.mod.json (1.21.4 → 1.21.11)
- Added LockConfig with toggleable immunities (hopper, piston, explosion)
- Added LockableContainers supporting any Inventory-implementing BlockEntity (modded containers)
- Added chest labeling with /scl label, /scl rename, /scl unlabel
- Added /scl help command with all command syntaxes
- Added /scl list with pagination (5 per page), showing index, type, coords, dimension, and label
- Added double chest support (lock/unlock/trust/label applies to both halves; shown as a single entry)
- Added container indices (Container 0, Container 1, ...) for remote management
- Made labels and indices interchangeable as command targets (labels take priority)
- Allowed label-based trust/untrust/players/unlock/unlabel without needing to look at the chest
- Added /scl gui with a full menu system (main menu, container list, manage, trusts, label)
- Added sign-editor input for entering player names and labels in the GUI
- Added cross-dimension remote administration
- Added command suggestions for targets, labels, and players
- Made saved data parsing backward compatible (optional dim field)
- Switched to official Mojang mappings; updated Fabric/Loom/Gradle versions; renamed namespace
